lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows, forming a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a rectangular pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running the length of the visible mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior margin and base of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and apparent tissue loss along the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe; a distinct notch is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermiculated (maze-like) pattern of light-intensity pixels located on the lower lateral flank, ventral to the primary carinae and posterior to the pectoral fin.
